Here are a few cosmetic steps to think about before your first infusion on November 3.

First, your likeness has been captured while your hair, brows, and skin tone are as you know them. This gives us your baseline measurements: shoulder-length wavy brown hair, soft-angled brows, and your natural tones.

Second, consider looking at wigs or soft headwear now. Hair often begins to thin around day 18 (around November 21). Looking early gives you time to match pieces to your own hair color and texture without rushing, and to have them ready at home.

Third, gather gentle, fragrance-free skincare. Simple cleansers and moisturizers can help keep your skin feeling comfortable.

Brows and lashes usually thin later than scalp hair. When the time comes, we can draw them back in using your measured brow color and shape.
